credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: At the top of this abstract composition, billowing pink forms spread horizontally across the canvas over a yellow background. Below these is a band of black paint, then curling red, pink, and orange horizontal forms that resemble the unfolding petals of a flower.
title: Red, Yellow and Black Streak
